headline: Central Bank of Nigeria Requires $11 Million Paid-Up Capital for Stablecoin Issuers
summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria ruled that issuers of US dollar-backed stablecoins must establish a local corporate entity with at least $11 million in paid-up capital to receive operating licenses.
why: Nigeria is one of Africa's largest cryptocurrency and digital asset trading markets.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Nigeria's central bank imposed an $11m capital requirement on dollar stablecoin providers.
